editions.title: The view was only the beginning.

photo.alt: Limestone cliffs and turquoise water on my Philippines trip

editions.excerpt: A bus ride that kept getting longer. Rooftop sunsets with friends. A kayak beneath El Nido's cliffs. And weather that had other ideas about our plans.

editions.title: Back to Thailand.

photo.alt: Longtail boats beneath the limestone hills of Khao Sok

editions.excerpt: I have been looking back through my Thailand photos and Polarsteps notes. Twelve more photographs now sit alongside the story of my three-month exchange, with memories of settling into student life, Bangkok from above, lake days in Khao Sok

editions.title: El Nido, from above.

photo.alt: Green cliffs and turquoise water in El Nido, Philippines

editions.excerpt: I’ve added a new moment from the Philippines: a short film from a tour I took in El Nido, with green cliffs, clear water and boats between the islands.
